inputs.name: Sample options
inputs.description: The samples to compare, each with the genome BAM an RNA-Seq execution produced for it.

input.name: Samples
input.description: One row per sample. Choose each sample's genome BAM from its RNA-Seq execution (the STAR 'markdup.sorted.bam'), and give it a condition that matches the contrasts file.

columns.name: condition
columns.description: Group this sample belongs to, as named in the contrasts file. Letters, numbers, dots and underscores; must start with a letter.

columns.name: strandedness
columns.description: Library strandedness. rMATS needs the real value; 'auto' is not accepted here.

columns.name: single_end
columns.description: true for single-end libraries, false for paired-end.

columns.name: genome_bam
columns.description: Genome-aligned BAM from a splice-aware aligner (STAR), from the same genome and annotation as below.

contrasts.name: Contrasts
contrasts.description: CSV with columns contrast,treatment,control, one row per comparison. treatment and control are condition names from the samples table, e.g. 'KD-CTRL,KD,CTRL'.

source.name: Source
source.description: Flow runs rnasplice from BAMs produced by the RNA-Seq pipeline.

inputs.name: Genome options
inputs.description: Use the same genome and annotation as the RNA-Seq execution that produced the BAMs.

gtf_extra_attributes.name: GTF Extra Attributes
gtf_extra_attributes.description: GTF attribute used for additional gene identifiers.

gtf_group_features.name: GTF Group Features
gtf_group_features.description: GTF attribute used to group features.

rmats.name: Run rMATS
rmats.description: rMATS is the reason this pipeline is on Flow, so it always runs.

rmats_read_len.name: Read length
rmats_read_len.description: Length of each read in the BAMs. rMATS needs the real value; there is no safe default.

rmats_paired_stats.name: Paired statistics
rmats_paired_stats.description: Only for paired designs, where each treatment replicate has a matched control. Leave off for independent groups.

rmats_splice_diff_cutoff.name: Splicing difference cutoff
rmats_splice_diff_cutoff.description: Cutoff used in rMATS's null hypothesis test for differential splicing.

rmats_novel_splice_site.name: Detect novel splice sites
rmats_novel_splice_site.description: Also detect events that use unannotated splice sites.

rmats_min_intron_len.name: Minimum intron length
rmats_min_intron_len.description: Minimum intron length, used with novel splice site detection.

rmats_max_exon_len.name: Maximum exon length
rmats_max_exon_len.description: Maximum exon length, used with novel splice site detection.

inputs.name: Other splicing methods
inputs.description: Exon-level methods that also run from genome BAMs.

suppa.name: Run SUPPA
suppa.description: SUPPA needs Salmon quantification, which BAM input does not provide.

multiqc_title.name: MultiQC Report Title
multiqc_title.description: Title printed at the top of the MultiQC report.

outputs.name: rMATS results
outputs.description: rMATS differential splicing events per contrast (*.MATS.JC.txt and *.MATS.JCEC.txt for SE, A5SS, A3SS, MXE and RI), plus summary.txt.

outputs.name: DEXSeq results
outputs.description: DEXSeq differential exon usage results, when enabled.

outputs.name: edgeR results
outputs.description: edgeR differential exon usage results, when enabled.

outputs.name: MultiQC report
outputs.description: QC report for the BAMs (samtools stats).
